Enyimba’s struggles in the Nigeria Premier Football League continued on Sunday as their losing streak extended, while Inter Lagos finally ended their eight-game winless run with a victory over Abia Warriors. The People’s Elephant suffered another setback against Ikorodu City, leaving the nine-time champions with more questions to answer as they battle to move away from the relegation zone. Enyimba went into the Matchday 13 fixture under pressure after losing 1-0 to Ranchers Bees in Minna last weekend. They had been 18th on 11 points before the encounter, having recorded three wins, two draws and seven defeats in their opening 12 matches. At the Mobolaji Johnson Arena in Lagos, Inter Lagos secured their first league victory in eight games with a win over Abia Warriors, ending a difficult spell for the newly promoted side. The result provides a much-needed lift for Inter, who had struggled for consistency since their only previous league victory, a 1-0 away win over Enyimba in September. People’s Elephant keen to escape relegation zone Leaders face tough task in Minna Tigers, Maliya Boys share points in stalemate Meanwhile, Rangers maintained their position at the top of the table despite being held to a draw by Niger Tornadoes in Minna. The defending champions went into the match with 24 points from 11 games and were looking to extend their advantage over their closest challengers. Katsina United also strengthened their title ambitions, moving into second place after defeating Nasarawa United at the Muhammadu Dikko Stadium. The results provided another twist in the race at the top, while Enyimba’s continued struggles leave the Aba giants facing an increasingly difficult campaign. Kindly share this story:
